title: thymus serpyllum var. glaber
intro: Thymus serpyllum var. glaber, commonly known as glabrous wild thyme, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Thymus serpyllum var. glaber include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help in alleviating digestive issues, colds, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include thymol, carvacrol, and rosmarinic acid, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-diarrheal activities.
